Name: Fresh Fish
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]The fish can be found all over the valley, even with one being in the mines and volcano caldera.

The event is called [b]Bonito Bonanza[/b], it starts Spring 26th and ends on the 28th.

On Fall 1st Year 1, if you have level 7 fishing you'll get a piece of mail from a [b]new suspicious friend[/b].

There are [b]5 Fish Boxes[/b] for different areas that will be available after Fall 15th Year 1 and Level 4 fishing, 3 are available from Willy, the other 2 from shops on Ginger Island(Volcano Dwarf after level 7 fishing and Island Trader Bird).
